{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''individual''' was a missionary of the [[Tyia]] philosophy. Circa [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], this individual traveled aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Revyia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Tyia philosophy resonated with the Revwiens, who soon embraced it. They later spread the Tyia philosophy around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
This information contradicts the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''.
